h1: Custom Gildan Fleece for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Gildan fleece in bulk. Perfect for company uniforms and team apparel. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Gildan fleece is a go-to choice for bulk apparel because it combines durability with consistent sizing and softness. The Heavy Blend™ 8 oz 50/50 fleece resists shrinking and pilling, making it ideal for embroidered logos or screen-printed designs. Whether you need crewnecks, hoodies, or sweatpants for your team, Gildan offers reliable quality at a practical price point for large orders.
heroAltText: Custom Gildan fleece hoodies and crewnecks with embroidered logos for company uniforms
